build.compiler_version:
clang version 23.1.3 (https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project.git 0d261d1ca552c95a8f007e061c787ac7132fbcbc)
Target: x86_64-w64-windows-gnu
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: ${TOOLCHAIN}
Configuration file: ${TOOLCHAIN}/x86_64-w64-windows-gnu.cfg

metadata.build_verification: Release cache and optimized benchmark compile command inspected; executable/source correspondence requires a fresh build
metadata.mode_order: alternated by workload/size; each mode uses a separate process
metadata.timing_scope: engine add/cancel plus returned event destruction; no parsing, IO, engine construction/destruction, invariant checks, or workload generation
metadata.allocation_scope: separate untimed pass counting book PMR upstream requests with sizes/alignments; excludes ordinary event vectors, pool object, and process RSS
metadata.path_policy: absolute repository/build/toolchain/home prefixes are replaced by placeholders; other absolute path tokens retain only basename
